tips.analysis: Both sides have been prolific in recent CAF qualifying rounds. Mauritania, playing at home, have scored in 5 of their last 6 internationals. Niger have conceded in their last 4 away games. Expect goals in this West African friendly.

Two of the continent's strongest women's national teams meet in a pre-tournament friendly. Nigeria's Super Falcons are the most decorated in AFCON history. Senegal have improved dramatically — BTTS in a close, competitive match.

Egypt's women's team are the dominant force in North African football. Tunisia will be competitive but Egypt's home advantage and squad depth make them clear favourites. Double chance at strong value.

The CAF CL Final between Africa's two most dominant clubs. Sundowns' fast transitions and Al Ahly's clinical finishing have combined for high-scoring encounters — both sides have scored in 8 of their last 9 CAF knockout ties.

Super Eagles at home have won 11 of their last 12 qualifying games. Rwanda have conceded 2+ goals in 4 of their last 5 away qualifiers. With Osimhen leading the line, a commanding home win is expected.

Nigeria's Super Eagles face Portugal in a high-profile pre-World Cup friendly. Victor Osimhen, Ademola Lookman and Samuel Chukwueze are in devastating form. Nigeria have scored in 8 of their last 10 internationals — back the Eagles to find the net.

The Lions of Teranga are reigning AFCON champions and unbeaten in 9 home qualifiers. DR Congo are inconsistent away from home. Sadio Mané's leadership and the Dakar atmosphere give Senegal a clear edge.

Bafana Bafana face a daunting World Cup opener against the hosts. Mexico's attacking depth and passionate home support make them clear favourites. South Africa will defend deep — back Mexico to win or draw.

Usyk is the most complete heavyweight of his generation — elite footwork, ring IQ and a chin tested at the highest level. In their first meeting Usyk's movement and jab neutralised Dubois's power entirely. Expect another masterclass.
